content: Please note that after receipt the processing time may be up to 20 working days.
If marital status is single, divorced, or widowed: Copy of civil status certificate (not older than three months)
If marital status is married or in a registered partnership: Copy of marriage certificate (or family record booklet) or partnership certificate
Copy of an official, signed identity document of the pension account holder
Copy of an official, signed identity document of the spouse/registered partner
The documents submitted will not be returned. Copies are accepted. Documents in foreign languages must be submitted with a certified translation into German, French, Italian, or English.
If the retirement assets are pledged, the pledgee (e.g., the bank) must cancel the pledge. A copy of the pledge release must be submitted.
Reaching 60 years of age
Definitive emigration from Switzerland (Condition: Neither working nor living in Switzerland)
Cross-border commuter with definitive termination of employment in Switzerland
Disability with recipient of a full disability pension from AI/IV
Start of self-employment in Switzerland
Payout request due to low vested benefits assets
Certificate of departure for emigration
Confirmation of residency abroad
Expired cross-border commuter permit
Disability decree from AI/IV
Admission confirmation from AHV compensation fund
Latest pension certificate
Transfer UBS (CH) Vitainvest funds to custody account
Sell UBS (CH) Vitainvest funds
The pension account holder confirms that the application and documentation provided are correct and complete.
Authorizes the Vested Benefits Foundation of UBS AG to make necessary inquiries.
Agrees to the terms outlined in the information sheet 'Payout UBS vested benefits account.'
Pursuant to Swiss federal law, payouts in excess of CHF 5,000 may be subject to taxation or disclosure.
Withholding taxes are applied if the account holder resides abroad or lacks consistent domicile information.
No withholding tax applies if taxes are proven to have already been paid before payout.
Withdrawals from pension fund buy-ins are restricted for three years after the buy-in date.
EU/EFTA residents may only withdraw the non-mandatory portion unless no social security obligations exist in the destination country.
Pension assets can be withdrawn five years before or after AVS/AHV retirement age.
